ngwe01.title: How Aries loves in winter
ngwe01.caption: Aries, you're first out the door when the snow hits, and that energy is a gift. Just warm their hands before you race the hill. Love goes best at a pace you share.

ngwe02.title: How Taurus loves in winter
ngwe02.caption: Taurus, your love looks like blankets, soup and slow Sundays. The coziest thing you can do this winter is scoot over and make room for them on the couch.

ngwe03.title: How Gemini loves in winter
ngwe03.caption: Snowed in, Gemini? Twenty texts can't do what one call does. Send the message, then dial. Let them hear you laugh.

ngwe04.title: How Cancer loves in winter
ngwe04.caption: Cancer, you're the one with the cocoa, the extra blanket and the hand-knit socks. This winter, let someone bring the mug to you. Being cared for counts too.

ngwe05.title: How Leo loves in winter
ngwe05.caption: Leo, you warm up every cold room you walk into. The loving move is saving the best seat by the fire for them. Shine beside them, not over them.

ngwe06.title: How Virgo loves in winter
ngwe06.caption: Virgo, the scarf, the gloves and the backup scarf are all love, and they notice. Add one more thing to the list this winter: tell them how you feel, out loud.

ngwe07.title: How Libra loves in winter
ngwe07.caption: Libra, you could plan the prettiest winter walk in your sleep. Try handing them the map this time. Letting them choose is its own kind of romance.

ngwe08.title: How Scorpio loves in winter
ngwe08.caption: Long nights and deep talks suit you, Scorpio. You don't have to open up all at once. Let them in one layer at a time, at a pace that feels safe.

ngwe09.title: How Sagittarius loves in winter
ngwe09.caption: Sagittarius, you can pack for a snow trip in four seconds. Before you go, ask whether they want the adventure or the sofa. A good trip can wait a weekend.

ngwe10.title: How Capricorn loves in winter
ngwe10.caption: Capricorn, you show love by shoveling their path before they're even awake. Don't slip away afterwards. Knock, and let them say thank you.

ngwe11.title: How Aquarius loves in winter
ngwe11.caption: Aquarius, a snow robot that says hi is a very you way to flirt. Big gestures are fun, but sometimes all they want is a simple hello from you.

ngwe12.title: How Pisces loves in winter
ngwe12.caption: Pisces, crying at the first snowflake isn't too much. It's how you love. Bring that soft heart into winter and feel it all, out loud.

ngwe13.title: Aries' holiday blind spot
ngwe13.caption: Aries, saying yes to every party for both of you comes from a good place. Their calendar is theirs, though. Ask first, then RSVP together.

ngwe14.title: Taurus' holiday blind spot
ngwe14.caption: Taurus, your traditions are part of who you are. Theirs are too. This year, try one bite of their holiday and see what it adds to yours.

ngwe15.title: Gemini's holiday blind spot
ngwe15.caption: Three parties in one night is a lot of fun and not much time together. Gemini, pick one, stay till the last song, and stay where they are.

ngwe16.title: Cancer's holiday blind spot
ngwe16.caption: Cancer, you host it all and eat last, and usually cold. The people at your table came to see you. Sit down, pass the plate and let yourself be a guest.

ngwe17.title: Leo's holiday blind spot
ngwe17.caption: Leo, the perfect holiday photo can take a while. They just wanted to be in it with you. Keep the blurry one where you're both laughing. That's the real one.

ngwe18.title: Virgo's holiday blind spot
ngwe18.caption: Virgo, fixing the tree at midnight is very you. That crooked star might be the one they hung, though. Leave it. Some things are perfect because they're crooked.

ngwe19.title: Libra's holiday blind spot
ngwe19.caption: Two families, one night, and you said yes to both. Libra, you can't please everyone at once. Choose one, say so kindly and plan the other for another day.

ngwe20.title: Scorpio's holiday blind spot
ngwe20.caption: Scorpio, not every gift tag is a clue. Sometimes a mug really is just a mug. If you're wondering what something meant, ask them. Don't try to decode it.

ngwe21.title: Sagittarius' holiday blind spot
ngwe21.caption: Sagittarius, your holiday trip isn't the problem. Telling them the night before is. Share your dates early because they care where you'll be. And send a postcard.

ngwe22.title: Capricorn's holiday blind spot
ngwe22.caption: "Just one email" can eat a whole holiday, Capricorn. The work will still be there tomorrow. They miss you, so close the laptop and play the game.

ngwe23.title: Aquarius' holiday blind spot
ngwe23.caption: Going quiet at a big family dinner doesn't make you weird, Aquarius. You're watching. When you're ready, pick one person and ask one question. It opens the whole room.

ngwe24.title: Pisces' holiday blind spot
ngwe24.caption: Pisces, you remembered everyone this year, even the neighbour's cat. What's on your list? Your wishes count too, so ask for the hug.
